rows.hypothesis: Models will retrieve individually relevant hops but lose answer correctness or conclusion support when the final answer requires evidence composition.
rows.contrast: multi-hop synthesis vs native single-row or first-evidence baselines
rows.confirm_rule: After HF-derived scale clears, confirm only if the category shows a deficit on at least two primary metrics for multi-hop synthesis vs native single-row or first-evidence baselines and the expected failure signature appears in scored errors.
rows.partial_rule: Treat as partial support if metric deficits appear but failure signatures are mixed, or if failure signatures appear without a stable metric deficit.
rows.falsify_rule: Treat as falsified or requiring revision if scored systems do not show the expected failure signature and primary metrics are indistinguishable from easier lookup-style controls.
minimum_evidence: 30 HF-derived paper-eligible items in the category
two or more eligible model baselines scored on the same derived source
error codes aligned to expected failure signatures
final novelty audit allowing the claim boundary
